caption:
Everyone blames the mattress for a stiff neck by morning. The pillow is usually the actual problem.

A flat pillow lets your top shoulder collapse forward, twisting your neck out of line for eight hours straight. That's what leaves you stiff, not the mattress underneath.

The Eli & Elm Side Sleeper Pillow uses a U-shaped cutout so your shoulder can settle into the mattress instead of pressing into the pillow, keeping your neck and spine in one line.

It's latex, queen-size, built specifically for side sleeping, and priced at $114.99 — far less than replacing a mattress that was never the actual problem.
